name: ClosingTheGapRegistration
title: Closing the Gap Registration
description: This extension applies to the Patient resource and provides an indicator of whether the patient is eligible for a Closing the Gap (CTG) co-payment.

element.short: Closing the Gap co-payment eligibility indicator
element.definition: Indication of eligibility for the Closing the Gap co-payment.
element.comment: This concept is equivalent to Australian Institute of Health and Welfare data element 603671 [Patient—Closing the Gap co-payment eligibility indicator](https://meteor.aihw.gov.au/content/index.phtml/itemId/603671).
